title: Chiral separation of aromatic amino acids by capillary electrophoresis using sulphated β-cyclodextrin as a single chiral selector: an experimental and computational study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2663-2670
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07410J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdalla A. Elbashir, Rehana Bano, Béla Fiser, Oliver J. Schmitz
Chiral discrimination of aromatic amino acids is crucial in biochemical, pharmaceutical and analytical sciences, yet a clear and mechanistic understanding of cyclodextrin-mediated enantioseparation in capillary electrophoresis (CE) remains incomplete.
